fightSong.title: Climb and Drop
fightSong.lyrics: Click click click up the track / Orlando's coming, no turn back / Hands up, here we go / Rollercoasters steal the show!

stadium.name: The Loop
stadium.tradition: The Drop — stadium lights go dark, a coaster sound plays, then lights blast on at kickoff. Kids love it, adults scream.

fanCulture.description: They keep their hands up on third downs. After big plays they do the 'coaster arms.' It's touristy and proud.
fanCulture.tailgate: In a parking lot that charges $40.

rivalries.name: The I-4 Corridor
rivalries.narrative: 90 minutes of I-4 traffic and hatred.

paAnnouncer.firstDownCall: First down! Keep your hands inside!

cityFlavor: Theme parks, tourists, and 3pm thunderstorms. We live where you vacation.
